company.name: Eco
company.shortDescription: Eco is the stablecoin network that makes money programmable across every major blockchain.
company.description: Eco is the stablecoin network that makes money programmable across every major blockchain, including Ethereum and Solana. Leading companies use Eco to move stablecoins such as USDC and USDT with a seamless user experience and best-in-class execution: cross-chain transfers and swaps, programmable payment flows, and more complex automations. Eco Routes provides a permissionless, cross-chain stablecoin liquidity layer, and Eco Accounts give users unified balances and one-click actions across chains. Money simply moves smarter with Eco.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $60,000,000, or 63.49% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,577,686 to $531,497,675, a 70.14x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 72 (+10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
